Name: Extended Fridge SMAPI
Author: Mystra007
Description:
This mod extends the fridge up to four pages of items (144 items), and all items work with crafting recipes. The items are loaded/saved into the normal game save without issues. Scroll between pages using the arrows keys.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility notes[/size]
[list]
[*]Not compatible with custom farmhouse interiors that change the fridge position.
[*]Not compatible with any mods that extend the inventory menu.
[*]Semi-compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url]. (When accessed directly, you'll see this mod's UI; when accessed remotely, you'll see Chests Anywhere's UI.)
[/list]
[size=5]Future plans[/size]
[list]
[*]Use the same technique to make bigger chests.
[*]Compatibility with mods that extend the inventory menu.
[/list]
